channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Aaron Wiggins | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Aaron Wiggins from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Aaron Wiggins
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Aaron Wiggins handling his limited role in these playoffs:

“Like a total pro, just like everybody else. I think all these guys' willingness to accept their role at any given point in time, which is not permanent, it changes constantly. But their willingness to accept it and stay inside the team and continue to put the wind at their teammates' backs has applied pressure to everybody to continue to do that.”

Mark Daigneault on Aaron Wiggins, May 15, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chet Holmgren on Aaron Wiggins
item.description:
Chet Holmgren on Aaron Wiggins:

“I think every team could use an Aaron Wiggins. I don’t think there’s something out there he can’t do at a high level…It’s not unexpected from any of us. We see how hard he works.”

Chet Holmgren on Aaron Wiggins, Feb 10, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Aaron Wiggins
item.description:
Joel Lorenzi:Mark Daigneault on Aaron Wiggins’ decreased minutes this past week:

“When a guys not playing as much, it’s usually about what someone else is bringing. I have a lot of trust in him,he’s got a great body of work. …. Any time a guy like that plays less than their normal dosage of minutes, it’s less on them. I don’t really coach like that.”

Mark Daigneault on Aaron Wiggins, Dec 19, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Josh Giddey on Aaron Wiggins
item.description:
Josh Giddey on Aaron Wiggins:

“I thought Wiggs’ minutes tonight were awesome. Defensively, he was great. Offensively, he plays such a simple game, but is so effective for us.”

Josh Giddey on Aaron Wiggins, Apr 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @joe_mussatto.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Aaron Wiggins
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Mark Daigneault on Aaron Wiggins’ contract:

“Really happy for him. Impressed. When you start as a 2nd round pick, you gotta be a guy that will beat the door down. Wiggins had that spirit about him. Good combination when you got a guy that’s smart and tough.”

Mark Daigneault on Aaron Wiggins, Feb 12, 2022. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.
